card.name: Release of antidiuretic hormone, early-timing phrases
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "inducing the release" in the opioid-diuretic interaction sentence. It also fires weakly on small words in time phrases such as "within 24 hours" and in the middle of "cholinergic".

modes.label: release of hormone
modes.description: The word "of" after "release" just before "antidiuretic hormone" in the opioid-diuretic interaction text.
modes.example: Opioids can reduce the efficacy of diuretics by inducing the release<< of>> antidiuretic hormone.

modes.label: within 24 hours
modes.description: The word "within" or the space after it, before "24 hours" in myocardial infarction dosing or overdose timing.
modes.example: Give 5 mg<< within>> 24 hours of MI.

modes.label: inside cholinergic
modes.description: The middle piece of the word cholinergic.
modes.example: responsive to reversal of ch<<olin>>ergic effects by atropine.
